newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela stocks fall ahead of pay rises.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela stocks fall ahead of pay rises.

text.p: Venezuelan shares were mostly down on Monday on thin volume as traders held back ahead of announcements of salary increases expected over the next few days.

The stock market index fell 0.77 percent (48.95 points) to close at 6,271.12 points, according to the stock market's prelimininary announcement. The Merinvest index slipped 0.67 percent to 96.60 points.
Twenty stocks fell, nine were unchanged and six rose on volume totalling 1,643.87 million bolivars ($3.4 million).
"We are getting close to May 1 and there is a lot of expectation in the market. People are waiting salary rise announcements," said Profimerca broker Miguel Gonzalez.
In the local debt market, Brady Par A bonds worth a nominal value of $10.97 million traded and the price fell to 69.54 percent from 70 percent on Friday.
